case: Computed CAST-to-BLOB result through JSON, XLSX and typed CSV consumers
contract: A computed CAST(value AS BLOB) expression over a STRICT ANY source covers INTEGER, REAL, numeric/text strings, empty text, nonnumeric text, BLOB and SQL NULL inputs.
The expression reports fallback column metadata while SQLite typeof() supplies the runtime class and hex() provides an independent exact-byte oracle for every row.
JSON represents computed BLOBs as escaped text, and XLSX writes non-NULL computed BLOB results as shared strings without formulas.
BookieE's typed CSV encoding is imported into another STRICT ANY table; persisted typeof(), bytes and hex() match the source oracle, including empty BLOB and SQL NULL.
